name: Place a restricted hold on a member account
goal: Look up the member by member number, open their profile, and click 'Place Account Hold'. This is a restricted function. Select the given account_no from the Account dropdown by its exact account number, select the given reason from the Reason dropdown (exact option text), and click Place Hold. Read back the confirmation reference shown after posting. This action is irreversible once posted.

inputs.name: account_no
inputs.description: Account number to place the hold on.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Hold reason, exact option text from the dropdown.

outputs.name: confirmation_ref
outputs.description: Confirmation reference shown after the hold is posted.

business_outcomes.description: The member number does not exist.
The account already has an active hold -- a legitimate rejection.

known_interstitials.description: Host-maintenance session notice that occasionally interrupts navigation.
